column1: # paragraph|location|cast@framing@authored action, four successive beats on the unchanged camera axis

1|manor-hall|Alix,Etienne,Henri,Jeanne@wide@Alix sits sceptical at the family table while the others welcome Etienne.|Etienne@close_up@Etienne presents one small olive cloth pouch with nervous mitten hands.|Henri@medium@Henri unrolls one parchment on the table, taking attention away from the present.|Alix,Henri@medium@Alix raises an open palm to ask a question and Henri finally looks at her.

2|manor-courtyard|Alix@wide@Alix stands in the ordinary manor courtyard with well and stable behind her.|Alix,Martin@medium@Martin hands Alix one folded household linen beside the courtyard bench.|-@insert@A bread loaf, plain bowl and folded linen rest on a wooden tray at the courtyard bench.|Alix@close_up@Alix glances back toward the manor doorway, thoughtful about the gathering inside.

3|manor-hall|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix watches Etienne as he talks across the table.|Henri,Etienne@medium@Henri leans forward to ask Etienne a practical question while Alix is outside this crop.|-@insert@The gift pouch and wax-sealed parchment sit clearly separated on the oak tabletop.|Alix@close_up@Alix tilts her round head and evaluates the visitor with a tiny doubtful mouth.

4|manor-hall|Henri,Jeanne@wide@Henri and Jeanne discuss the proposed match across the table.|Henri,Etienne@medium@Henri indicates the place for a guest while Etienne listens formally.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix and Etienne speak to one another without touching, the table between them.|Alix,Henri@medium@Alix turns back toward Henri with her hands open in disagreement.

5|manor-hall|Henri,Etienne@medium@Henri and Etienne examine the same parchment laid flat on the table.|-@insert@Two rolled parchments and a red wax seal lie beside a closed plain wooden box, no readable writing.|Jeanne@close_up@Jeanne studies the document with a serious expression.|Alix@medium@Alix reaches toward the agreement to look more closely before accepting anything.

6|private-chamber|-@wide@The quiet private chamber contains writing desk left, bed centre and chest right, no people.|-@insert@A sealed roll lies next to a closed plain-bound book on the writing desk.|Alix@medium@Alix sits at the desk comparing two blank-looking parchment sheets.|Alix@close_up@Alix touches the edge of the wax seal and considers the promise attached to it.

7|manor-hall|Jeanne@medium@Jeanne watches Etienne off frame from beside the table.|Jeanne,Alix@medium@Jeanne speaks quietly to Alix with one practical guiding gesture.|-@insert@A ring of ordinary iron household keys lies beside a folded linen on the table.|Alix,Jeanne@close_up@Alix listens closely as Jeanne points toward the key ring.

8|manor-hall|Etienne,Alix@medium@Etienne offers the small cloth pouch across the table and Alix accepts it politely.|Alix@close_up@Alix holds the gift in both mitten hands and examines its simple tied cord.|-@insert@The opened cloth pouch contains one plain unmarked metal brooch, not coins or a modern ring box.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix looks from the brooch to Etienne, still uncertain about the man.

9|manor-hall|Henri,Alix@medium@Henri gestures toward Etienne while Alix turns her attention toward the agreement.|Jeanne,Alix@medium@Jeanne lays the household keys beside the document as Alix watches.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix tries to speak directly to Etienne while their empty chairs and table retain the established layout.|Alix@close_up@Alix lifts one hand slightly to ask whether the match can be delayed.

10|private-chamber|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix and Etienne stand beside the desk discussing the marriage with open hands.|-@insert@A closed plain religious book with a tiny unlettered cross on its cover rests on the desk.|Alix@close_up@Alix touches her own chest with a clear thoughtful expression to indicate her personal decision.|Alix,Jeanne@medium@Jeanne listens to Alix while the unopened correspondence lies on the desk.

11|manor-hall|Alix,Henri@medium@Alix asks for time with an open palm while Henri pauses with the document.|Henri@insert@Henri's mitten hand stops above the unrolled agreement, no second person in frame.|Etienne@close_up@Etienne nervously points at his small gift pouch again.|Jeanne,Etienne@medium@Jeanne kindly redirects Etienne with a question and he relaxes enough to answer.

12|manor-courtyard|Alix,Etienne@wide@Alix and Etienne talk privately across the courtyard near the bench.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix raises a questioning hand while Etienne answers without touching her.|Alix@medium@Alix glances toward the manor entrance and hesitates before walking back.|Alix@close_up@Alix holds a folded letter and considers where she could seek help.

13|manor-hall|Alix,Etienne,Henri,Jeanne@wide@The four adults gather warmly after agreement, with two plain cups and bread added to the same table.|Jeanne,Alix@medium@Jeanne adjusts the edge of Alix's linen veil before the modest gathering.|Etienne,Alix@medium@Etienne offers Alix a cup and she accepts with a small genuine smile.|Alix@close_up@Alix looks toward the doorway with a mixture of pleasure and apprehension.

14|private-chamber|-@wide@The private chamber is quiet with a closed door, ordinary bed, chest and desk, no person.|-@insert@Two folded adult outer garments rest neatly on the bed edge, nobody undressed or present.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Fully clothed Alix and Etienne sit separately beside the desk and speak gently about household expectations.|Alix@close_up@Fully clothed Alix holds a folded linen in her hands and listens thoughtfully.

15|private-chamber|Alix@wide@Alix stands in the unfamiliar chamber surveying the desk, bed and chest.|Alix@medium@Alix opens the foreground-right wooden chest to find neatly folded household linen.|-@insert@An iron key rests above folded linen inside the open chest.|Alix@close_up@Alix turns toward an off-frame voice, asking where another household object belongs.

16|estate-storeroom|Alix,Martin@wide@Martin shows Alix the storeroom shelves, sacks and counting table.|Martin@medium@Martin points to a sack on the shelf and a plain parchment record on the table.|Alix@medium@Alix examines a delivered cloth bundle and considers where to store it.|Alix,Martin@close_up@Alix asks Martin a pointed practical question with one open hand.

17|estate-storeroom|Martin@medium@Martin stands by one sack and explains the count with a closed record in hand.|Alix,Martin@medium@Alix gestures toward the shelf and asks where the missing delivery was placed.|-@insert@One numbered-by-knots plain cord and an unopened grain sack sit on the counting table, no legible marks.|Alix,Martin@medium@Martin opens the record while Alix lifts her skirt hem clear of the dusty floor and approaches.

18|estate-storeroom|Alix@medium@Alix compares a plain delivery note with goods on the counting table.|Martin,Alix@medium@Martin offers an explanation while Alix listens before making a decision.|-@insert@A small closed coin purse and a plain empty bowl sit apart on the table, suggesting a delayed purchase.|Alix@close_up@Alix indicates which bundle should be moved first with a clear small directing gesture.

19|manor-courtyard|Alix,Martin@wide@Alix stands by the well while Martin carries one filled wooden bucket nearby.|Alix,Martin@medium@Alix steps aside and Martin sets the bucket safely on the ground.|-@insert@The bucket rests on the earth beside the well, rope fixed to the windlass.|Alix@close_up@Alix listens respectfully to Martin off frame as a practical question is answered.

20|private-chamber|-@insert@A closed manuscript and a quill lie beside the sealed agreement on the writing desk.|Alix@medium@Alix studies a plain-bound book at the desk, an illustrative reader rather than a historical portrait.|-@insert@A small stack of handwritten-looking parchment pages has abstract marks only, no title, author or forged quotation.|Alix@close_up@Alix traces a place on the page with a mitten fingertip and considers an idea.

21|manor-hall|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix and Etienne sit at the same table while a small folded infant-sized linen lies untouched in a basket, no child.|Alix@close_up@Alix's polite expression tightens when an unseen relative raises a personal question.|-@insert@The small linen basket rests separately from the adult cup and bread, no person or suggestive imagery.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Etienne notices Alix's discomfort and turns toward her rather than continuing the conversation.

22|private-chamber|Alix,Etienne@medium@Alix explains her worries to fully clothed Etienne across the small writing desk.|Alix@close_up@Alix rests both hands on the folded household linen while speaking calmly.|Etienne@close_up@Etienne listens attentively, his gift pouch now tied normally at his belt.|Alix,Etienne@medium@Etienne raises one hand gently in acknowledgement and Alix relaxes a little.

23|private-chamber|Alix@medium@Alix sits at the writing desk considering how to address a letter.|Alix@insert@Alix's mitten hand holds one quill above a fresh folded parchment sheet, no readable words.|Alix@close_up@Alix pauses with the quill and looks toward the sealed agreement beside her.|Alix@medium@Alix smooths the sheet and starts a careful practical request.

24|private-chamber|Alix@medium@Alix folds the completed letter and seals it with plain red wax.|-@insert@The newly sealed request rests beside the older agreement, clearly two separate documents.|Alix@medium@Alix opens a returned folded reply at the desk.|Alix@close_up@Alix sets the reply beside the original agreement and nods with greater confidence.

25|private-chamber|-@insert@The closed household agreement lies beside a single unused adult cup on the desk.|Alix@medium@Alix studies the agreement alone, quietly considering a possible future change in circumstances, not visibly grieving an actual death.|Alix@close_up@Alix points to the seal while holding the reply in her other hand.|Alix@medium@Alix places both papers carefully inside the foreground-right wooden chest for safekeeping.

26|private-chamber|Alix@medium@Alix reopens the foreground-right chest and takes out the familiar sealed agreement.|-@insert@The old wax seal is recognizable beside the newly folded reply, no readable writing.|Alix@close_up@Alix studies the two documents together with a practical resolved expression.|Alix@medium@Alix gathers the papers and stands to ask about the household arrangements.

27|estate-storeroom|Alix,Martin@medium@Alix brings the agreement to Martin at the counting table.|Alix@close_up@Alix points to a specific place on the unreadable parchment while asking for an explanation.|Martin@close_up@Martin lowers his record and pays closer attention to Alix off frame.|Alix,Martin@medium@Alix and Martin compare the two papers calmly on the counting table.

28|manor-hall|Alix@wide@Alix sits upright in her established chair at the family table.|-@insert@The gift brooch and familiar sealed agreement lie side by side again.|Alix,Henri@medium@Henri listens as Alix confidently sets out a practical question.|Alix@close_up@Alix finishes speaking with a calm steady expression and open hand.

29|manor-hall|Etienne,Alix@medium@Etienne speaks to Alix at the same table with the gift pouch between them.|Alix,Henri,Jeanne@wide@Alix now participates actively in the family conversation while Henri and Jeanne listen.|Alix@close_up@Alix's tiny mouth curves in quiet amusement at the memory of the awkward first meeting.|-@insert@An empty high-backed household chair remains behind the oak table, with one plain cup and closed parchment on the tabletop, no jester or new person.
